headline: Alinta Energy Scraps $1.8 Billion NSW Pumped Hydro Project
summary: Alinta Energy has withdrawn plans for the $1.8 billion Oven Mountain pumped hydro energy storage project in northern New South Wales due to economic challenges.
why: Pumped hydro projects require significant capital expenditure, making them vulnerable to macroeconomic cost pressures.

impacts.name: Renewable Energy
impacts.why: Escalating project costs can lead developers to shelve capital-intensive energy storage investments.
